description: Assigns an organization member to a PostHog role. Memberships cannot be changed in place: changing any property replaces the membership.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

OrganizationId.description: ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization the role belongs to.

RoleId.description: ID (UUID) of the role to add the member to.

UserUuid.description: UUID of the user to add to the role. The user must be a member of the organization.

JoinedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user was added to the role.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
